hero.introBody: Single-origin from our 35-hectare farm. Farm OS traceability on every shipment. Export-ready documentation. No middlemen — just direct, transparent sourcing from Odienné to your container.

whyDifferent.title: Why Our Cashews Are Different
whyDifferent.body: Most cashew suppliers are traders — they buy from whoever has nuts and resell to whoever needs them. We farm our own land and buy from partner farmers we know by name, track every batch with our own software, and provide documentation most suppliers cannot.

traceability.title: Full Traceability
traceability.desc: Every batch traced to the exact block and harvest date. Our Farm OS gives you data most suppliers cannot provide — not just a paper trail, but a digital record.

consistency.title: Single-Origin Consistency
consistency.desc: No mixed origins. No middlemen. Every batch comes from Odienné — our family farm and partner farmers graded to one standard. Same soil, same climate, same quality, every time.

documentation.title: Export-Ready Documentation
documentation.desc: Full export package: COO, SGS, Phyto, Organic and Halal certs (as achieved). Your customs broker will have everything they need.

blockTracking.description: Our Farm OS maps every block by row, column, survival rate, and GPS coordinates. Each block has its own planting date, tree count, and harvest history. When you ask for traceability, we show you the actual data — not a promise.
blockTracking.title: Block-Level Tracking: See What Others Can't Show

cta.body: Register your volume for our first season, download our product catalogue, or review our compliance documentation. We respond to wholesale inquiries within 24 hours. Once you submit, we will schedule a call to discuss your volume and quality requirements.
cta.title: Ready to Source With Confidence?

faq.body: Quick answers for wholesale buyers. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us directly.

items.a: We are registering buyers for our first season, for shipment from the Port of Abidjan to the European Union, the Middle East, and North America. Transit times: 4-6 weeks to EU, 6-8 weeks to North America.
items.q: Do you ship to my country?

items.a: Absolutely. We encourage qualified buyers to visit our 35-hectare farm in Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire. Seeing the operation firsthand builds the trust that documentation alone cannot. Visits are arranged on request.
We are actively pursuing Organic (target 2029), Rainforest Alliance (target 2029), Fair Trade, ISO 22000 and Halal (target 2030). Our farm has been chemical-free since inception.
Our standard MOQ is 1 metric ton (approximately 20 jute bags) for raw cashew nuts. For processed kernels and specialty products, MOQs vary — contact us for details.
items.q: What is your minimum order quantity?

items.a: Every batch comes from one origin — Odienné. Our family farm and partner farmers are graded to one standard, and we don't mix origins. Our Farm OS tracks quality metrics per batch, and we provide documentation with every shipment.
items.q: How do you ensure consistent quality?

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

farmOs.body: Our custom-built Farm OS tracks every block, every expense, and every harvest. When your volume ships, we don't just ship cashews — we ship a digital record of exactly where they came from, when they were harvested, and how they were handled.
farmOs.title: Ask Your Current Supplier for Block-Level Traceability Data. We'll Wait.

farmOsQuote.body: When you order from AfriNuts, the traceability report is pulled directly from Farm OS — not created after the fact by someone in an office. Same system our farm managers use. Same data our investors see.
farmOsQuote.title: Most Suppliers Send a Certificate. We Send the Data That Generated It.
